description: Find verified Dongbang Interior (동방인테리어) construction cases from public Soomgo customer reviews. To read a specific reference, pass its exact public id from search results, caseReferences or a canonical ABIS case URL. Otherwise filter by service, building type or a Korean keyword such as 중문, 욕실, 구축, 타일. Returns the review month, work items, customer highlights, a short excerpt and the canonical case page URL. Cite only the case returned. An unknown id yields no match. The tool returns public records and links.

id.description: Exact public case ID returned by case search or answer references.

query.description: Korean keyword such as 중문, 욕실, 도배, 구축, 타일.

service.description: apartment, villa, house, bathroom, entrance (중문·신발장·가벽) or finishing (도배·장판·타일).

name: search_construction_cases
title: 실제 시공 사례 찾기
